title: Renew the Oura access token when it expires
description: Adds RotatingTokens, a TokenSource that loads the token pair from a store and, once the access token has expired, exchanges the refresh token for a new pair and stores it. The store and Oura's token endpoint are interfaces, so a later story can back them with Secret Manager and the real endpoint. Unit tests cover an unexpired token, a rotation and a failed refresh.
